title: Full Day Peggy's Cove and Lunenburg Tour and Titanic Cemetery
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the stunning coast of Nova Scotia on a private tour that includes iconic Peggy's Cove, the UNESCO World Heritage site of Lunenburg, and charming Mahone Bay. This flexible journey allows you to personalize stops, enjoy local treats like gingerbread and coffee, and take in breathtaking views at your own pace. With expert local guides leading the way, you’ll gain unique insights into the culture and history of the region. Ideal for small groups seeking a tailored experience, this tour promises comfort and convenience with door-to-door pickup.

- Private door-to-door pickup from your accommodation
- Scenic drive along the majestic coastal landscapes
- Ample time for photos at Peggy's Cove lighthouse
- Customizable itinerary to suit your group’s interests
